ED_Title: Implementation of the resolutions of the United Nations
ED_DecisionText: At its 115th plenary meeting, on 4 September 2026, the General Assembly decided to include the item entitled “Implementation of the resolutions of the United Nations” in the draft agenda of the eighty-first session.
ED_Disclaimer: The final text of this decision will be contained in document A/80/49 (Vol. III) after editorial review.
